vale.hall.mural: The Vale, painted by the artists who lived here, one long summer. Each of them added one thing. The paint is flaking now.
vale.hall.jade_hills: 'Jade Hills.' Oil on canvas, painted from the overlook. The artist's name has worn off the frame.
vale.hall.eco_hill: 'A Night On Eco-Hill.' The first painting ever hung in this hall, says the old catalogue.
vale.hall.kitemaster: 'Kitemaster '95.' Left to the Vale by a painter who went to the city and never came back.
vale.hall.boat: 'Boat.' Painted on the lake at dawn. The rowboat is still out there.
vale.hall.needlepoint: 'Needlepoint Flower.' Stitched, not painted. The Vale's artists argued for a week about whether to hang it.
vale.hall.panel: Studies of the Vale by its past artists, pinned up here so they wouldn't be lost.
vale.hall.panel_b: A sunset over the lake, unsigned. Someone has pencilled 'too orange' on the back.
vale.hall.bowls: Bowls from Tobin's kiln. A note in his handwriting: 'They're for using. Don't just look at them.'
vale.hall.jug: A jug from Tobin's kiln, slip white and slate blue. 'Land of Clay' was painted at the pit its clay came from.
vale.hall.flowers: Wildflowers from the Vale's meadow, pressed and labelled by Fern. Some of the labels are jokes.
vale.hall.flowers_b: More of Fern's pressed flowers. One label just says 'Do not water.'
vale.hall.spiral: 'Spiral.' Carved from river stone found below the falls, and set on a block of the same slate.
vale.hall.heron: 'Heron.' Bronze, on the green marble plinth its sculptor brought from the coast. She refused to show it on anything else.
vale.hall.kiln_woman: 'Kiln Woman.' Terracotta, fired in the pottery's kiln long before Tobin's time. Her plinth is bricks from the kiln's first chimney.
vale.hall.moss_figure: 'Moss Figure.' Its sandstone plinth was the old studios' doorstep, and the moss came with it. Fern says that moss only grows on old statues.
vale.hall.visitors_book: The Hall's visitors' book. Its first pages are full of names from long ago.
vale.hall.poster: A poster for the Vale's last exhibition. The date has faded away.
vale.hall.vista: 'Vista.' Still hanging where it was left the night the last exhibition closed.
vale.hall.calico_falls: 'Calico Falls.' A painter's souvenir of the desert, says the old label.
vale.hall.sheeted: Paintings under a dust sheet. Nobody has lifted it in years.
vale.hall.crates: Packing crates. One was opened, and never closed again.
vale.hall.crates_b: Crates of frames, waiting to go back to artists who never came for them.
vale.hall.ladder: The ladder they used to hang the last exhibition.
vale.hall.unshown: A sculpture that never made it out to the gallery.
vale.hall.frame_rack: Empty frames, saved for paintings nobody has painted yet.
vale.hall.dancing_grass: 'Dancing Grass.' Too tall for the gallery's walls, so it hangs back here.
vale.hall.ledger: The Hall's ledger: every painting ever shown here, in the same careful handwriting.
vale.hall_closed.mural: The Vale, painted by the artists who lived here. Nobody could take it down when the Hall closed. Dust has settled along the top of it.
vale.hall_closed.panel: A display under a dust sheet. Something tall.
vale.hall_closed.panel_b: Another tall shape under a dust sheet. A corner of a gilt frame shows at the bottom.
vale.hall_closed.case: A glass case under a dust sheet. Something inside clinks when you touch it.
vale.hall_closed.case_b: A glass case under a dust sheet. Through a moth hole: something pressed flat, and a paper label.
vale.hall_closed.statue_round: Something round and heavy under a dust sheet, on its plinth. It feels like stone.
vale.hall_closed.statue_moss: A figure under a dust sheet. Moss has crept up the hem of it.
vale.hall_closed.statue_kiln: A figure under a dust sheet, on a plinth of old bricks.
vale.hall_closed.statue_heron: Something tall and thin under a dust sheet. It seems to be standing on one leg.
vale.hall_closed.desk: The front desk under a dust sheet. A corner of the visitors' book pokes out.
vale.hall_closed.bench: A bench under a dust sheet, still facing the mural.
vale.hall_closed.frames: The paintings from the walls, taken down and leaning under a sheet.
vale.hall_closed.hook: A nail, and a paler square where a painting hung.
vale.studio.unfinished: An unfinished painting of the Vale at sunset. Half of it is still pencil lines. Nobody knows who painted it.
vale.studio.note: A folded note in a careful hand. It isn't addressed to anyone.
vale.studio.sketches: Charcoal studies for the painting on the easel: the valley, a figure, a pair of hands, over and over.
vale.studio.backward: A painting turned to face the wall. Someone hung it that way, and never turned it back.
vale.studio.window: The tall north window, grey with dust. Painters chose this studio for its light.
vale.studio.trestle: A trestle crusted with years of paint, in every colour the Vale has.
vale.studio.cot: A bed with a thin, worn mattress. Whoever worked here slept here too.
vale.studio.washstand: A cracked jug in a dry basin.
vale.studio.trunk: A trunk, locked. The key is nowhere to be found.
